name: table-column-resizer
title: Table column resizer
description: A drag handle for a column header that resizes with the pointer or arrow keys, with limits, a reset and a live width.
docs: Place it inside a TableHead with className relative, hold the width in state and pass it as width and onWidthChange. Put the same width on the header cell and set table-layout fixed on the table, with a table width that is the sum of its columns. Pass defaultWidth so Enter and a double-click can reset the column, and onResizeEnd to save the widths. The handle of the last column stays inside its cell, so the table is never wider than the sum of its columns. Left and Right move 8 pixels (32 with Shift), Home and End go to the limits.
